planets.name: TOI-4507 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4507 with a 105-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-4507 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4507. Its orbit and size follow Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ESPINOZA_RETAMAL_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2025, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 104.616063, pl_radj 0.73155626, pl_bmassj 0.06292704

quotes.title: TOI-4507 b
quotes.card: TOI-4507 b is an exoplanet discovered in October 2025 that is roughly 578 light-years away.
quotes.introduction: It is a similar size to Jupiter; however, it is roughly 30 times the mass of Earth.
